$description: Kindred design tokens (DTCG format). Source of truth for src/design/tokens.ts (generated) and the future web app. Values come from docs/design/m1-figma-brief.md: status "approved" is a founder-approved value (brand identity, the approved accessibility corrections B1 and B2, and the approved control specification); status "default" is an implementation default documented in that brief, never a founder-approved design (ADR 0022).

contrastPairs.usage: Wordmark, tagline and field labels on the page
Log In button label (Inter Medium 20 is normal text)
Log In button label while pressed
Log In button against the page (non-text, WCAG 1.4.11)
Field outline against the page (non-text, WCAG 1.4.11)
Field outline against the field (non-text, WCAG 1.4.11)
Focused field outline against the page (non-text, WCAG 1.4.11)
Focused field outline against the field (non-text, WCAG 1.4.11)

terracotta.$description: Primary Terracotta, Kindred's primary brand colour.

terracottaButton.$description: Accessible button variant (B1, approved 2026-10-17): the fill of primary buttons carrying white text, and the focused field border (founder decision 2026-10-18). Not a replacement for the brand colour.

apricot.$description: Secondary Apricot. Not used on the Milestone 1 screens; a fill behind Charcoal text only, never text or a control's only boundary.

sage.$description: Success Sage. Not used on the Milestone 1 screens; a fill behind Charcoal text only.

inputBorder.$description: Original Figma input border, recorded as the design value. Replaced for fields by color.border.input (B2).

splash.$description: Splash and native launch screen background.

link.$description: Charcoal, not underlined, as in the Figma frame (2026-10-18). Terracotta text would be 3.60:1 and fail.

focus.$description: Focused field border #A94F32, shown together with the 2 pt width (founder decision 2026-10-18; supersedes Terracotta #C96A4A approved 2026-10-17).

screenMarginStart.$description: Left margin: the label glyphs start at x 32 in the 402 pt frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

screenMarginEnd.$description: Right margin: the fields end at x 371 in the 402 pt frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

brandTopLogIn.$description: Top of the wordmark line box on Log In, from the top of the screen; puts the wordmark glyphs at y 114 as in the frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18). Never above the safe area.

brandTopSplash.$description: Top of the wordmark line box on the splash; puts the glyphs at y 321 as in the frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18). Never above the safe area.

brandGap.$description: Wordmark line box to tagline line box (applied as a top margin): the tagline glyphs start 18 pt below the wordmark baseline (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

brandToForm.$description: Tagline to the Username row; the first field starts at y 330 (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

row.$description: Between the Username and Password rows: fields at y 330-382 and 389-441 (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

label.$description: Minimum gap between a label and its field, beside or above it; small enough that the 199 pt field still fits beside "Username:" at 390 pt.

labelRaise.$description: Bottom margin that raises a side-by-side label 2 pt within its 52 pt row: label glyphs 15 to 16 pt below the field top, as in the frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

beforeButton.$description: Password field to the Log In button: button at y 481-533 (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

beforeLink.$description: Log In button to the 48 pt link touch target; puts the link glyphs at y 554 (Figma frame export 2026-10-18).

screenBottom.$description: Space below the content when the screen scrolls.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum touch target (handoff rule; WCAG 2.5.8 needs 24px).

fieldWidth.$description: Field width beside its label: x 172-371 in the 402 pt frame (Figma frame export 2026-10-18). Shrinks to size.minFieldWidth on narrow screens, then labels stack.

minFieldWidth.$description: Labels stack above their fields when a label and a field this wide no longer fit on one line.

base.$description: Bundled with the app (SIL Open Font License 1.1) in weights 400, 500, 600 and 700.

label.$description: Field labels: Inter Regular 24, letter spacing 0%, #2F2F2F, from the Username: text layer in Figma (founder, 2026-10-18).

link.$description: Forgot your password?: Inter Regular 16, Charcoal, the design brief default, consistent with the Log In export. Not underlined, as the approved reference shows (founder, 2026-10-18).

heading.$description: Multiplier for text 20 pt and larger.

body.$description: Multiplier for text 16 pt and smaller.

wordmarkMax.$description: The wordmark grows with the system text size up to 1.5x, then shrinks to fit its line.

splash.$description: Milliseconds on the splash before Log In.
